name: XCC_BCE_LEDGERS
description: This table holds the enablement information for Budgetary Control and Encumbrance Accounting for a specific ledger. A row will exist in the table only after an end-user would have gone through the Enablement pages for this ledger. If a ledger does not have any corresponding row in this table, it will be considered not enabled.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Represents the ledger primary key.

columns.name: BC_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Budgetary Control Enablement indicator, it is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: EA_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Encumbrance Accounting Enablement indicator, it is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: LOCKED_FLAG
columns.description: Budgetary Control or Encumbrance Accounting Enablement Locked indicator, it is a Yes/No flag.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate the option for Control Budget selection, whether it is for Ledger, Project or Both.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_REASON_REQ_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if an override reason must be provided for this ledger when requesting and performing override.

columns.name: BUDGET_DATE_RANGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if budgetary control must check that the transaction date is within the valid budget date range defined for the ledger.

columns.name: START_BUDGET_DATE
columns.description: Date from which budgetary control is allowed for the ledger.

columns.name: END_BUDGET_DATE
columns.description: Date till when budgetary control is allowed for the ledger.

columns.name: COA_CONTROL_BUDGET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether Budgetary Control must check for an impact to the chart of accounts control budget.

columns.name: BC_AR_REVENUE_CASH_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether budgetary control for revenue from AR receipt transactions funding a cash control budget is enabled. Possible values are Y or N.

columns.name: BC_AR_REVENUE_EXPENSE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether budgetary control for revenue from AR receipt transactions funding a procure to pay control budget is enabled. Possible values are Y or N.

columns.name: BC_AP_PAYMENT_CASH_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether budgetary bontrol for AP payment transactions consuming a cash budget is enabled. Possible values are Y or N.

columns.name: VALIDATE_AR_REVENUE_ACCT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether validation of revenue account on AR invoice agaisnt revenue estimate is enabled. Possible values are Y or N.

columns.name: DISABLE_BC_JOURNALS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether budgetary control for journals is disabled. Possible values are Y for disabled or N for enabled.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
